Per the WHO classification, 'pheochromocytoma' (and its adrenal/chromaffin/intra-adrenal synonyms) is reserved for tumors of the adrenal medulla; extra-adrenal counterparts are instead termed paragangliomas. This term is therefore restricted to the adrenal gland, a proper subset of the code's ceiling (which also includes mediastinal/thoracic sympathetic paraganglioma sites C381/C382/C383/C388/C398).
